title: Variance-aware signed circuit cutting
difficulty_explanation: The solution must combine signed fragment reconstruction, TensorCircuit boundary-state experiments, derivative-aware integer shot allocation, and canonical seeded sampling.

seed_protocol.base_seed_mapping: The single base seed initializes one NumPy Generator stream that emits eight ordered cases and each case's canonical sample_seed.
seed_protocol.determinism_scope: Exact public case and sampling bytes are deterministic under the pinned runtime and are identified by the evaluator-emitted case_digest.
seed_protocol.case_identity: SHA-256 of canonical JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over the ordered exact public cases, including canonical sample seeds; functional stdout emits the full case_digest and protocol_seed in one structured orbit_q_case_identity JSON line.
seed_protocol.pinned_numpy_note: The target image pins NumPy 2.2.6; a seed alone is not a cross-runtime case identity, so trial manifests must bind the image/runtime and case_digest.

contract.hidden_case_source: explicit evaluator --seed, otherwise verifier-only ORBIT_Q_CANDIDATE_SEED, legacy ORBIT_CUTTING_SEED, or local default 1042026
contract.determinism_scope: one base seed drives the ordered eight-case generator and its per-case sample seeds; trial evidence binds the pinned image and evaluator-emitted case_digest
contract.anti_hardcoding: The seed changes both fragments, observables, shot budgets, and sampling streams; oracle values are not passed to the solution.
contract.oracle: Independent complex128 NumPy fragments plus an uncut statevector identity canary

difficulty_levers: boundary state can be entangled with discarded left qubits
seeded finite-shot sampling in a canonical component order
claim_boundary: The expert and evaluator are validated prototypes. No solver-model trial has been run and no model-hardness claim is made.
api_risks: expectation_ps uses integer Pauli codes 0=I, 1=X, 2=Y, 3=Z; a convention drift silently changes observables.
TensorCircuit backend and dtype configuration is process-global.
The prescribed seeded sampler relies on NumPy Generator/PCG64 and must be version-canary tested if the image changes.
